game_title: Function Test Arena – Frosted Chapel Defense
game_concept: A tower defense set in Snowy Hold – Frosted Chapel, a frosted chapel: the sled courier must handle snow wraiths while practicing functions. Core idea – Function Test Arena: Write quick assert tests to confirm functions behave before facing snow wraiths.
theme: Snowy Hold – Frosted Chapel: a frosted chapel
core_gameplay_loop: In Frosted Chapel, repeat each round: Write quick assert tests to confirm functions behave before facing snow wraiths. Each round, snow wraiths strike the sleigh, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the tests_passed value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Protect the sleigh from snow wraiths in Frosted Chapel: keep the tests_passed meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 46-second timer ends.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: tests_passed drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 46-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 10 (extended tier): Function Test Arena
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how tests_passed changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against snow wraiths in Frosted Chapel.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 46 seconds while tests_passed > 0.
